ns2:section.sectionText: Closed - No late enrollment. Students must seek instructor approval if after the first day of class. Course can be accessed on Moodle. On campus class sessions are optional. The on campus session will be held on Wednesday in Burrill Hall, Room 124 beginning on January 26 from 12pm - 2:50pm. On campus (in person) sessions are NOT required, but highly encouraged (introductions, film, discussions, study sessions, group project assistance, etc.). Note: First session 8-week course
